validation_exclusions: Lake Crescent, Lake Chelan, and Cross Sound are calibration-only for this v2 method and cannot validate it.

dataset.title: Swath bathymetry and acoustic-backscatter data collected in 2013 offshore Maui and Kahoolawe, Hawaii, during field activity A-01-13-HW
dataset.selection_rule: Site identity frozen before any raster values are accessed; no switching among Puunua Point, Olowalu, or Kuia Shoal after outcomes.
dataset.sensor: SEA 234-kHz interferometric SWATHplus-M bathymetric sidescan sonar

scientific_goal: First unseen validation of KUSTO paired-support-domain v2 in a marine coral-reef setting after Cross Sound exposed control-domain degeneracy.

bathymetry_discovery.followup_rule: at least two morphology families in upper tail OR generic score in upper 0.5 percent
bathymetry_discovery.candidate_support: complete valid bathymetry support through maximum frozen radius 32 m

paired_support_domain_v2.rule: Backscatter controls are eligible only where an independently defined bathymetry-valid support mask covers the control patch; backscatter anomaly values may not define the control-support mask.

backscatter_replay.zero_mad_rule: exclude metric when same-radius eligible-control MAD is exactly zero
backscatter_replay.aggregate_score: 0.5*max(active positive robust z)+0.5*mean(active positive robust z)

promotion_requires_all: no radius stratum with fewer than 2 active nonzero-MAD metrics
candidate mean aggregate score > control mean aggregate score
primary_test.secondary: one-sided Mann-Whitney candidate aggregate scores > eligible controls
